title: The Elders of the School of Rav
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Bava Kamma 75a Rava said, “I defeated the elders of the school of Rav,” and Rashi explains that this is Rav Hamnuna, who is so called, as in Sanhedrin 17b. Hyman objects that there they said only “in the school of Rav they say — Rav Hamnuna,” and Tosafot there explain that it is Rav Huna.
